mapper.select: SELECT e.path AS "path" , e.method_id AS "methodId" FROM analysis_endpoint e WHERE e.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND e.path = #{path} AND e.method_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.endpoint_id
SELECT f.file_id AS "fileId" , f.path AS "path" FROM analysis_file f WHERE f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND (f.path = #{path} OR f.path LIKE '%/' || #{path}) ORDER BY length(f.path), f.path LIMIT 5

SELECT r.from_id AS "from" , r.to_id AS "to" , r.confidence AS "confidence" , r.properties_json->>'via' AS "via" , r.properties_json->>'script' AS "script" , r.properties_json->>'requestPath' AS "requestPath" FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.relation_type = 'REQUESTS' AND r.to_kind = 'METHOD' AND r.to_id IS NOT NULL AND r.from_id IN #{id}

SELECT r.from_id AS "from" , r.to_id AS "to" , r.properties_json->>'via' AS "via" , r.properties_json->>'script' AS "script" FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.relation_type = 'REQUESTS' AND r.from_kind = 'FILE' AND r.to_id IN #{id}

SELECT r.properties_json->>'script' FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.relation_type = 'REQUESTS' AND r.properties_json->>'via' = 'SCRIPT_SRC' AND r.properties_json->>'script' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.properties_json->>'script' HAVING count(DISTINCT r.from_id) > #{maxScreens}
SELECT r.from_id AS "from" , r.to_id AS "to" FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.relation_type = 'RENDERS' AND r.from_kind = 'METHOD' AND r.to_id IN #{id}

SELECT r.from_id AS "from" , r.to_id AS "to" , r.to_kind AS "toKind" , r.relation_type AS "type" , r.confidence AS "confidence" FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.from_kind = 'METHOD' AND r.to_id IS NOT NULL AND ((r.to_kind = 'METHOD' AND r.relation_type IN ('CALLS', 'CALLS_POSSIBLE_IMPLEMENTATION', 'ENCLOSES_ANONYMOUS')) OR (r.to_kind = 'SQL' AND r.relation_type = 'EXECUTES_SQL') OR (r.to_kind = 'FILE' AND r.relation_type = 'RENDERS')) AND r.from_id IN #{id}

SELECT m.method_id AS "methodId" , s.fqn AS "owner" , s.layer AS "layer" , m.signature AS "signature" , m.is_synthetic AS "isSynthetic" , f.path AS "path" , m.line_start AS "lineStart" , m.line_end AS "lineEnd" FROM analysis_method m LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = m.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = m.owner_symbol_id LEFT JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = m.file_id WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.method_id IN #{id}

SELECT 'S' || mp.mapper_id AS "id" , COALESCE(mp.namespace || '.', '') || mp.statement_id AS "statement" , mp.statement_type AS "statementType" , f.path AS "path" , mp.line_start AS "lineStart" , mp.line_end AS "lineEnd" , (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT t.to_external || '(' || (CASE WHEN t.relation_type = 'READS_TABLE' THEN 'R' ELSE COALESCE(t.properties_json->>'crud', 'W') END) || ')', ', ') FROM analysis_relation t WHERE t.revision_id = mp.revision_id AND t.from_id = 'S' || mp.mapper_id AND t.relation_type IN ('READS_TABLE', 'WRITES_TABLE')) AS "tables" FROM analysis_mapper mp JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = mp.file_id WHERE mp.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND mp.mapper_id IN #{id}
SELECT 'F' || f.file_id AS "id" , f.path AS "path" , f.line_count AS "lineCount" FROM analysis_file f WHERE f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND f.file_id IN #{id}
SELECT e.method_id AS "methodId" , e.path AS "path" FROM analysis_endpoint e WHERE e.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND e.method_id IN #{id} ORDER BY e.path
